Chapter 362: Chapter 16 The Confused Ancestral Demon Tree (Please Subscribe)_2

Of course, while the Thunder Creation Pearl was mighty and terrifying, its flaws were also quite evident.

One of which was the lengthy activation time, and during the activation period, it would emit thunderous fluctuations.

At that time, even a fool could tell that you were preparing to use your trump card.

By then, there would be ample time to consider whether to temporarily avoid the brunt of its force.

However.

The flaw of the Thunder Creation Pearl.

...

To the soon-to-arrive Ancestral Demon Tree.

Was tantamount to nonexistent.

Lin Yuan could calculate the timing perfectly.

He could activate the Thunder Creation Pearl in advance, so that by the time the Ancestral Demon Tree descended into the Tianqing World,

the activation of the Thunder Creation Pearl would have nearly reached its end.

The Ancestral Demon Tree would probably not have reacted before it had to confront the earth-shattering might of thirteen Thunder Creation Pearls.

“Still, the sensation is a bit off.”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly.

The stone sword, the World Sword, flew out, landing in front of the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

This world weapon could only be activated by the creatures of this world; as for Lin Yuan? Even if he could completely suppress the World Sword, he couldn’t activate it.

After all, the evil demonic force of the Demon Tree was diametrically opposed to the pure power within the World Sword.

During the time Lin Yuan held the World Sword, his main goal was to use it to comprehend the operations of the Tianqing World.

“Can you assure that with this sword, you can deal with that Foreign Evil God?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the Tianqing Alliance Leader and asked.

The World Sword was the strongest foundation of the Tianqing World, and naturally, Lin Yuan could not let it go to waste.

Since he himself couldn’t activate it, then he would let the original owner of the World Sword do so.

After all, Lin Yuan had now completely taken control over the Tianqing Alliance Leader, and to him, the World Sword was merely going through the motions.

“Master, rest assured.”

“With this sword in hand, just by myself, I can surely suppress that Foreign Evil God.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader was visibly excited.

The closer the World Sword was to the Tianqing World, the greater its might.

Now that the World Sword was within the Tianqing World, its power was unbelievably strong.

“It’s almost time.”

Lin Yuan checked once more and nodded slightly.

In truth, even if the Ancestral Demon Tree expended everything to withstand the ‘Yin-Yang Reversal Heaven and Earth Extermination Nine Heavens Great Formation,’ to withstand the destructive ‘Thunder Creation Pearl,’ to withstand the Tianqing Alliance Leader wielding the World Sword,

It would still have to face the most terrifying existence.

And that was Lin Yuan himself.

In over a hundred years, thanks to his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan himself did not know the extent of his strength, because so far, there hadn’t been anyone who had forced him to exert his full power.

Even when dealing with the Tianqing Alliance Leader, Lin Yuan had done it effortlessly, without spending a bit of energy.

Time passed.

In a blink, three days later arrived.

The Ancestral Demon Tree was still somewhat uneasy, and checked one last time with Lin Yuan.

“You’re sure the surroundings of the spatial channel you’re about to open are safe, right?” the Ancestral Demon Tree asked solemnly.

Lin Yuan looked at the several hundred experts ready for battle, the Thunder Creation Pearl emitting a world-terminating vibration, himself still holding the World Sword, and the Tianqing Alliance Leader exuding a terrifying presence.

“Absolutely safe.”

Lin Yuan nodded and encouraged, “Ancestor, you can rest assured, don’t you trust me?”

After assuring the Ancestral Demon Tree a few more times, Lin Yuan began to open the spatial channel.

Hum.

A faint power of space began to fluctuate.

An entrance was beginning to form.

…

Outside the world.

The form of the Ancestral Demon Tree was now less than sixty meters tall.

“The spatial channel has finally begun to open.”

“I’ve waited too long for this day.”

The Ancestral Demon Tree looked at the gradually forming spatial channel, somewhat tearful with emotion.

“Just under half an hour.”

“All I need is less than half an hour.”

“Then I can successfully perform the secret technique and merge within the Origin Source of the Tianqing World.”

The Ancestor meticulously calculated the time.

Even though the moment the spatial channel was opened, the resultant spatial fluctuations would inevitably spread in every direction,

by the time the powerhouses of the Tianqing World took notice, it would have been far too long.

A mere half an hour was far too short for the entire Tianqing World.

Unless upon his arrival, there was a large group of Tianqing World powerhouses waiting in strict formation,

no one else could prevent Him from merging with the Origin Source of the Tianqing World.

Once the merge was successful, after devouring all of the Tianqing World’s Origin Source, the Ancestral Demon Tree would become unprecedentedly powerful.

“Hahahaha.”

“Tianqing World, here I come.”

The Ancestral Demon Tree patiently waited for a while, confirmed the successful opening of the spatial channel, and then confidently entered the spatial channel entrance.

Hum.

The next moment.

As if crossing infinite distances.

When the Ancestral Demon Tree stepped out of the spatial channel,

it had arrived deep within the Black Mist Mountain Range.

“This is…?”

The Ancestral Demon Tree had yet to get a clear look at its surroundings when it caught a scent and its expression was one of pure enjoyment.

“A delicious scent…”

The Ancestral Demon Tree felt every pore in its body relax, a stark contrast to the harsh environment outside the realm.

Inside this world, the environment was filled with a gentle power that seemed like heaven to it.

“Hurry up and apply the secret technique.”

The Ancestral Demon Tree was aware of the gravity of the situation.

“Hm?”

The Ancestral Demon Tree began to observe its surroundings.

It quickly noticed Lin Yuan.

“You?”

With the world barrier gone, the Ancestral Demon Tree immediately sensed that Lin Yuan had grown to the Sixth Stage.

And he was at the limit of the Sixth Stage.

Far beyond what one at the beginning of the Fifth Stage could compare to.

In addition,

the Ancestral Demon Tree was shocked to discover,

it felt a faint, trembling presence emanating from Lin Yuan.

How could this be possible at this time?

Although the Ancestral Demon Tree currently had only half of its Origin Source and its strength was far from its peak,

it shouldn’t be like this when facing its own offspring, even if only one-tenth of the Origin Source was left.

“Something isn’t right.”

The Ancestral Demon Tree immediately came to its senses.

It was about to turn and return through the spatial channel to the outside of the world.

However,

Crack.

The spatial channel in front of it began to collapse bit by bit.

The Ancestral Demon Tree was stunned on the spot.

The next moment,

a terrifying aura erupted into the sky.

A set of formations, faintly radiating infinite might, unfolded, with the force of Yin-Yang Nine Heavens Extermination spreading throughout.

Immediately after,

thunder pearls began to emit extremely terrifying energy fluctuations.

Terrifying thunderous power permeated the area, transforming a million li around it into the Nine Heavens Thunder Pond, and under the extremely yang and rigid thunderous power, the Ancestral Demon Tree felt its consciousness dim and its remaining strength once again suppressed.

However,

this was far from over.

The Yin-Yang Reversal Heaven and Earth Extermination Nine Heavens Great Formation was fully activated, with hundreds of powerhouses striking simultaneously.

Next, the Tianqing Alliance Leader, wielding the World Sword, exerted all his strength in a slash, and within an instant, space was torn apart, and terrifying might descended.

“No!!”

Upon seeing this scene, the Ancestral Demon Tree’s scalp exploded.

“I am the Ancestral Demon!!!”

The Ancestral Demon Tree did not hesitate to reveal its True Body, its sixty-meter stature growing rapidly.

Rustle, rustle.

In just an instant, half of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s body was torn apart.

It made the Ancestral Demon Tree’s heart chill.

Before the Ancestral Demon Tree could take any action,

the next wave of attack surged over again.

“Ahhh!!!”

The Ancestral Demon Tree suddenly emitted a terrifying psychic fluctuation,

because it knew it probably wouldn’t leave the Tianqing World alive.

Boom, boom, boom.

Terrifying energy fluctuations poured down as if cascading.

Before death,

the Ancestral Demon Tree’s mind flickered with one thought after another.

Even now, it was unclear about what had actually happened?

Why were there so many powerhouses lying in ambush outside the spatial channel? And why were they using the Tianqing World’s ultimate power?

Could it be that the offspring Demon Tree had defected to the Tianqing World?

But that seemed even more improbable.

Whether it was the offspring Demon Tree or the Ancestral Demon Tree,

they stood in opposition to the Tianqing World, with no chance of reconciliation.

Even if the offspring Demon Tree wanted to defect, the Tianqing World would have to be willing.

If it wasn’t the offspring Demon Tree defecting, then did the Tianqing World control the offspring Demon Tree?

But that seemed equally impossible… As a descendant of a Foreign Evil God, it wouldn’t be so easily controlled; how else could the Ancestral Demon Tree have roamed outside the realm for so many years?

And just now, in a fleeting glance, the Ancestral Demon Tree perceived that the many powerhouses of the Tianqing World, including the strongest Tianqing Alliance Leader wielding the World Sword,

were all treating its offspring Demon Tree with the utmost respect?

Why was that?

Within the split second, one doubt after another flashed through the Ancestral Demon Tree’s mind.

Boom, boom, boom.

The Ancestral Demon Tree’s massive body was torn asunder.

Countless Origin Sources scattered, with exceptionally pure powers of evil emerging.

“Stop.”

Seeing this, Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly.

The remaining five-tenths of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s Origin Source began to converge in front of him, and he swallowed it all at once.
